subject: Recap: NexaHealth discovery — private deployment / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Berger <tom.berger@nexahealth.com>, procurement@nexahealth.com
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Recap: NexaHealth discovery — private deployment / next steps

Hi Tom / procurement team —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary use case: patient triage + anonymized summary generation from clinical notes (PHI-managed).
- Expected steady-state: ~1M tokens/day with spiky bursts up to 4M tokens/day.
- Key constraints: data residency (US), strict access controls, audit logs for inference requests.

Redwood recommendation
- Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem) — provides the isolation and KMS/HSM integrations you requested.
- Short-term pilot on Dedicated capacity to validate latency and throughput; follow with Private/VPC for production.

Attachments included
- redwood_private_factsheet.pdf (high-level architecture & options)
- soc2-extract-request.xlsx (short list of items we’ll need to accelerate SOC2 evidence review)

Proposed next steps
1) Procurement: if you can share the security questionnaire + any procurement deadlines, we’ll prioritize the SOC2 extracts.
2) Technical deep-dive (30 min) — I recommend looping in our Solutions Engineer (Dev Patel) to go over architecture and on-prem/VPC specifics.
3) Pilot scope & timeline: suggested 4–6 week pilot on Dedicated capacity; afterwards migrate to Private/VPC for production.

Can you share three windows next week for a short technical call? If preferred I can send a Calendly link.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood_private_factsheet.pdf; soc2-extract-request.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Berger <tom.berger@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Quick follow-up on Private/VPC option — availability for tech call?

Hi Tom —

Bumping this in case it got buried — did you have a chance to review the factsheet and the SOC2 extract list I shared? Wanted to check whether the Private/VPC path is still something you want to prioritize given the PHI requirement.

If it helps, we can schedule a 30-minute session with Dev (Solutions Engineer) to walk through a sample architecture and high-level cost ranges. We do have a couple of Q2 pilot slots that fill quickly; would hate for timing to push you past your target.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min

If priority/timing has shifted, a quick reply with status is totally fine — we’ll adapt.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Tom Berger <tom.berger@nexahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nexahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 11:20:00 -04:00 (EDT)
Subject: Re: Recap: NexaHealth discovery — private deployment / next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the follow-up and the detailed recap. A few quick items from our side: 

- We are still evaluating internally; interest is high in the Private/VPC option because of PHI handling, but procurement needs clarity on SLA, data residency guarantees, and the estimated TCO.
- On-prem is something leadership asked about — can Redwood support an air-gapped or on-prem flavor, or would that require a third-party integrator?
- Timeline: target decision by the end of Q2 if we can get the answers/procurement pack turned around.

I’ve looped in procurement (procurement@nexahealth.com). I’ve attached a vCard for our procurement lead to this reply and will ask them to complete the SOC/security questionnaire you included if that helps speed things up.

Appreciate the clarity on pilot timing. If you can provide a short note on SLA (uptime target / monitoring), high-level pricing bands for a pilot vs production, and whether on-prem is supported, we’ll route to procurement and leadership.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Berger <tom.berger@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 12:05:00 -07:00 (PDT)
Subject: Re: Recap: NexaHealth discovery — private deployment / next steps

Tom —

Thanks — that all makes sense and glad to hear interest remains. Quick answers and proposed immediate steps so procurement/leadership have something to act on: 

1) On-prem / air-gapped: yes — Redwood supports an on-prem deployment package for regulated customers. That path can be delivered as an air-gapped installer with a private control plane, or as a VPC customer-managed deployment depending on your preference. I’ve asked Dev (cc’d) to prepare a short note on the differences and the typical effort (we’ll attach a draft runbook).

2) SLA / monitoring: we offer SLA-backed uptime for Dedicated and Private customers. Typical SLA options: 99.5% (standard), 99.9% (enterprise). Full monitoring and request-level audit logs are available; we can include retention options to match your compliance needs.

3) High-level pricing bands (estimate for scoping only)
- Pilot (Dedicated reserved short-term): $8k–$18k/month depending on throughput and burst profile.
- Production (Private/VPC, small cluster): $25k–$60k/month depending on instance sizing, KMS/HSM, and ingress/egress patterns.

Next steps I propose this week
- Procurement: please send the completed SOC/security questionnaire (I included the extract list earlier) — we’ll return prioritized evidence within 3 business days where available.
- Technical: 30-min call with Dev to validate architecture and on-prem requirements. Dev, can you propose 2 windows tomorrow or Monday?
- Commercial: I’ll push a formal pilot estimate and a draft MSA/term sheet for review — I can route via DocuSign for quick signature when you’re ready.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567
Draft DocuSign (pilot estimate): https://docusign.com/placeholder/NH-2026-045

If procurement prefers, we can also schedule a separate 20-min call with our Security & Compliance lead — happy to set that up.

Thanks — I’ll follow up after Dev confirms times.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
